method:
Synthetic framebuffer proof of gallery/shelter visibility, not game progress.

Known blue subjects lie behind a flagged civic deck plus surface water, and
under a tagged shelter roof. Main-view changes must preserve reflection bytes
and respect the existing cutaway preference. Actual traveler captures are separate.

Shelter regression: the earlier noWater=True setup skipped reflection rendering
and compared the previous gallery texture. Every shelter frame now renders its
reflection freshly, with an empty-scene control proving geometry reaches it.

checks.name: Above-water diorama exposes known submerged subject through deck and water
Gallery aperture leaves actual reflected framebuffer identical
Ordinary water retains its opaque surface without a visited gallery
Disabled cutaway retains the original main image
Visited gallery reveals a nearby submerged reading outside the old body-only hole
Nearby gallery reveal preserves fresh reflection bytes
Nearby reveal is absent outside an actual visited gallery
Gallery reveal remains bounded and hides a distant submerged object
Visited shelter reveals a resident away from the narrow traveler aperture
Fresh shelter reflection contains geometry distinct from empty and prior gallery scenes
Shelter main-view reveal leaves reflected geometry identical
Disabled cutaway preserves the complete shelter roof
